judged_text: The diff swaps the two fabricator files' contents: Fabricator(:embeddable_host) now lives in category_fabricator.rb while all four category fabricators (category, diff_category, happy_category, private_category) moved into embeddable_host_fabricator.rb, whose blob hash (a37f5b4c8ba) is the old category file's. The next maintainer adding or editing a category fabricator opens category_fabricator.rb and finds the embeddable_host fabricator instead; fabricator changes land in misleadingly named files and future review diffs for category changes point at the wrong file.
